channel.title: Geektutu
channel.description: A personal tech blog that turns tutorial articles into readable books

item.title: A Gentle Introduction to Python
item.description: Learn Python 3 with a single article — installation, basic types (strings, ints, lists, dicts), control flow (if, for, while), composite types (classes, methods), functional programming, object-oriented programming, error handling (try/except/finally), pip and third-party packages, and how to write unit tests.

item.title: Go Context: A Quick Guide to Concurrency Control
item.description: WaitGroup and channels are two common ways to control concurrency, but for complex scenarios Context is a more elegant mechanism. Context provides four control mechanisms: WithCancel, WithValue, WithTimeout and WithDeadline.

item.title: A Quick Guide to mmap in Go
item.description: mmap maps a file or device into memory — a one-to-one mapping between the file's on-disk address and a range of the process's virtual address space. Reading or writing that mapped memory reads or writes the file at the corresponding position. This tutorial shows how to use mmap in Go.

item.title: A Quick Guide to gomock
item.description: gomock is the official Go mocking library for unit tests, useful when dependencies such as network requests, databases or file I/O are complex and hard to call directly. This tutorial covers matchers (Any, Nil, Not, Eq), return values (Do, Return, DoAndReturn), call counts (Times) and ordering (InOrder), and how to write mockable code.

item.title: Go Test: Unit Testing in Go
item.description: How to write unit tests in Go with the standard library testing package: subtests, table-driven tests, helper functions, setup and teardown, network/HTTP testing and benchmarks.

item.title: A Quick Guide to Go WebAssembly (Wasm)
item.description: Front-end development with Go, WebAssembly and GopherJS: registering functions, interacting with browser JavaScript objects, manipulating DOM elements, asynchronous programming with callbacks, plus more advanced demos (games, rendering) and related projects and documentation.

item.title: A Quick Guide to Go RPC & TLS
item.description: Remote Procedure Call (RPC) in Go with the standard library net/rpc: synchronous and asynchronous calls, plus one-way and mutual authentication between server and client using TLS/SSL.

item.title: A Quick Guide to Protocol Buffers in Go
item.description: Protocol Buffers (protobuf) is a language- and platform-neutral, scalable and extensible way to serialize structured data — smaller and faster than JSON or XML. This tutorial covers Protocol Buffers 3 (proto3): installation, basic syntax and how to use it in Go.

item.title: A Gentle Introduction to Rust
item.description: Rust is a systems programming language balancing safety, speed and concurrency. This tutorial covers Rust and Cargo installation, basic types (strings, ints), control flow (if, if let, while let, loop, for), composite types (struct, enum), error handling (panic, Result), Cargo project layout and testing Rust code.

item.title: A Quick Guide to Go 2
item.description: What changes in Go 2 compared to Go 1: the latest design drafts covering packages, error handling, error values and generics, plus a short history of the Go language.

item.title: Gin in a Nutshell
item.description: A quick-start tutorial for the Gin web framework: installing Go and setting up the environment, hot reload, routing and route groups, HTML templates, and middleware.

item.title: A Gentle Introduction to Go
item.description: Learn Go (Golang) with a single article — installation, basic types (strings, ints, arrays, slices, maps), control flow (if, for, for-range, switch), composite types (structs, interfaces, methods), concurrency (goroutines, channels, sync), error handling (panic, error), Go Modules and how to write unit tests.
